instructions: Fresh review of each primary candidate: read dialogue first, then exact cards. Assess all six unchanged criteria and all coach-2.0 gates with turn-specific evidence. For pairs, show whether the Stance changes HOW A pursues the Drive in one interaction. Do not invent missing backstory or assume prior approval. Use the alternate only to assess meaningful differentiation. Report actual reservations. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
productionStandard:
PRODUCTION STANDARD coach-2.0. Historical coach-1.0 acceptance is not coach-2.0 acceptance. Read the dialogue first and record what the spoken words establish before interpreting the card. Exact cards are already in this invocation: label internal-dialogue-first, never blind or human review. Do not invent a charitable backstory; harmless unspecified names/history are not defects. Fill coach2 for ORIGINAL dialogue in writer output and CANDIDATE dialogue in reviewer output. Copy the supplied dialogue hash for the text being assessed. Give concise actual turn evidence, not generic claims.
G1: legible immediate situation, wants/stakes; separate stated, ordinary inferred, and missing essentials. Identify first material defect or explicitly none.
G2: coherent facts, ownership, timing, language, knowledge; recognizable misunderstanding/revelation is allowed, unstated intervening events are not.
G3: assess all A1-B2, B2-A3, A3-B4, B4-A5 links. Vocabulary repetition alone is insufficient. Purposeful avoidance must read as behavior.
G4: B is a plausible participant with an intelligible practical/emotional position, not a contrived punchline cue. B can help, concede or solve.
G5: exact card changes A's choices. For pairs Stance changes HOW A pursues Drive and B responds to the merged behavior; neither card may be decorative.
G6: ending develops the same behavior using B4. Investigate if A5 would work after unrelated B4; more obstacles are not required for heightening.
format: five spoken ABABA turns, existing word/schema limit, no narration/coaching/truncation.
Every mandatory gate and transition is PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR with evidence; UNCLEAR cannot be accepted. All gates pass AND total >=85 AND fidelity/response >=4 AND others >=3; preserve the six weights 30/20/15/15/10/10. A 5 is not merely presence. Totals are derived in code. Retain good originals; no rewrite quota. Review both alternatives for different tactics, relationships or pressure. Scene outline identifies roles, task, A want, B want, stakes, exact-card tactic and B's contribution; it is private planning evidence, not a substitute for missing spoken facts. Humour must come from sincere priorities and responsive choices, not stock hierarchy or unrelated slogans. Record actual weaknesses and reservations. Writer corrections target only rejected/materially changed scenes; preserve all accepted records and prior original assessments exactly. No coach-1.0 failure or exhausted allowance is erased by this separately versioned cycle.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll name the coworker who reported your lateness if you name whoever reported mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only know which department.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then I'll trade departments. Names cost names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Payroll. But I can introduce you to my source.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Marketing. And I'll arrange coffee with mine. Same access, same price.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll tell you why I took Mum's spare key if you admit something that could get you grounded too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I broke her mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. That's a weekend. This key is a month. Have you got anything bigger?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I lent her car to Jamie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A month each, then. I used the key to let Jamie move into her flat.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll be honest about your missing donation box. You asked where I went; I said the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you take the box there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Yes. You didn't ask what was inside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Was the money still in it when you arrived?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the car park, yes. If you mean the counter, that's a different arrival.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Pass the talking cupboard a napkin. Let's make dinner normal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It doesn't have a lap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then put it beside the handle, like a considerate host.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should I offer it soup?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please. Ask which shelf it eats from. We can't keep making our guest explain everything.

beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Our invisible dinner guest is here. Will you introduce Mum while I finish the gravy?

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Stay until sunset. Gran predicted this stone would hatch, and I promised we'd witness the result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sun's down. It's still a stone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then help me record that it didn't hatch. We can put the prophecy to rest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sign, but Gran never said which day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay while we ring her and agree a deadline. I can't witness every sunset alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Keep your coat off. The prophecy says this bell-less tower will ring at noon; I need a witness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's twelve-oh-one. We heard nothing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then sign that before you go. We can officially stop waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My watch is five minutes fast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me four more minutes. I'll fill in our names so only the silence needs witnessing.

cards.title: The Conspiracy Expands
cards.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've taken charge of our missing toaster receipt. The shop has someone inside this house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I probably recycled it. May I ask them for a copy?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Request denied. The recycling crew removes originals and the shop supplies replacements. You'd be asking the network to certify itself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every shop prints replacement receipts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the whole high street is involved. Permission to trust any of them is suspended. Bring me our warranties; I'll decide which appliances are still allowed to disappoint us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You and your manager say my train is cancelled. I require an explanation for these matching stories; I have an interview.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: May I show you the board? A signal failed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're permitted to speak freely. Who recruited the board operators to keep me from that job?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The same fault is delaying three counties. It isn't aimed at you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three counties means government backing. You may stop protecting your manager; he's plainly too junior to arrange my replacement. Get me someone authorized to confess at that level.
